also: how many fingers am I holding up?

phrases.latin: Quīnque digitōs ostendere cōnātus, trēs ostendit.
phrases.english: Trying to show five fingers, he showed three.
to point the finger at someone
How many fingers am I holding up? — Three.

phrases.latin: Quot sunt in manū digitī? Numerēmus.
phrases.english: How many fingers are there on a hand? Let’s count them.

phrases.latin: sī digitōrum saltem incertō aut indecōrō gestū ā computātiōne dissentit, jūdicātur indoctus
phrases.english: if his fingers so much as stray from the sum with an unsure or clumsy movement, he is judged uneducated

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 58, 315.
